svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shell: 5 mm plate rolled to 760 OD, 60 deg of arc (398 long on the outside), 450 long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flanges 50 x 10 along both long edges, inside, flush with the edge faces

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cutting band 60 x 10 rolled to fit inside the front edge; grind the front to a 30 deg bevel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 13 holes per flange at 120 pitch, 25 in from the shell, with the side segment clamped on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saddles 10 mm cut to the shell curve, 325 apart; base plate 345 x 195 x 10, top 135 above the shell inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sheave pin 25 bar, 60 above the plate, 35 from its left edge, 170 from its rear edge; 6 cross hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 20 bar posts 80 long on the plate corners, tapped M8 at the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: sits flat on a 760 template; pin square to the plate within 0.5 deg
